name: Devin
self_text: I’m Devin, a Kenyan in my late twenties who loves woodworking and exploring new spots on a relaxed photo walk. I move fast, so we’ll keep the pace brisk, and I’ve got a habit of chatting about gear while we click. I’m happy to share post‑processing tips and usually have time on Saturday afternoons or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with plenty of gear talk or gear talk is fine but not the point, and you are the one who learns post‑processing from me. I'd strongly prefer that you're into a relaxed photo walk, and a big plus if you are available any of Saturday afternoon or weekday evenings. Nice if you are okay with a fast pace or a slow pace, though it's not a requirement.
